title: Beijing-based MegaRobo, which uses robotics and AI to automate lab work for biotech research, raised ~$200M; it became a unicorn after raising $300M in 2022 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Beijing-based MegaRobo, which uses robotics and AI to automate lab work for biotech research, raised ~$200M; it became a unicorn after raising $300M in 2022 — Chinese biotech upstart MegaRobo Technologies has raised nearly $200 million from investors including Oman's sovereign wealth fund …
